description: This Java class 'Conversations' models unread message conversations in a messaging application, including data structures for conversations, participants, and messages, as well as methods to generate sample unread conversations for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: Conversations
classes.description: A utility class that provides sample unread conversations with messages and participants for testing or demonstration purposes.

methods.name: getUnreadConversations
methods.description: Generates an array of unread Conversation instances with random data.

methods.name: makeMessages
methods.description: Creates a list of randomly selected messages for a conversation.

classes.name: Conversations.Conversation
classes.description: Represents a conversation with one participant, containing multiple messages, a unique ID, and a timestamp.

methods.name: getUnreadConversations
methods.description: Public static method to generate a specified number of unread conversations with a given number of messages per conversation.

methods.name: makeMessages
methods.description: Creates a list of randomly selected messages from predefined message templates.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected participant name from the predefined list.
